Aloo Parwal Sabzi
By: ravikumar
Published: Wednesday, May 23, 2018 - 2:29am

Ingredients




INGREDIENTS
300 Grams parval chopped
1 potatoes chopped
2 onion chopped
1/3 teaspoon turmeric
1 tablespoon chili powder
1 tablespoon Garam masala
Coriander
1 tablespoon Oil
Salt
Water

Preparation

1 DIRECTIONS 2 In a pan add oil, chopped onions, potatoes, pointed gourd, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala, salt and mix them together. 3 Cook them for 8-10 minutes. 4 Parwal batata vegetable is ready to serve

About

Get the delicious Parwal recipe to make your buds very curving. Here is an Aloo Parwal Sabzi which is very popular in Indian Food. It is very simple but tasty. It is one of the most common Indian Recipe. Parwal Recipe can be prepared in many interesting ways and one of them is Aloo Parwal Sabzi is a very simple, tasty and delicious. It’s Simple and quick Parwal fry with Aloo (Potato) very fewer ingredients. Its taste goes well with Dal and Rice and other snacks.
